label: scope4-cap-stalled-hardening-blocks
description: Authored Scope 4 convergence-precedence case: the stalled-window convergence block keeps precedence over the cap conversion, so a stall-tripped hardening finding terminal-blocks at the cap rather than converting. Replayed with review_stuck_window 2 (the test writes a neal.yml). roundLimit is 2 (default threshold 3). Round 1 raises a below-threshold hardening finding (C1) that stays round-forcing and unresolved. Round 2 (== the cap) adds no new findings, so the open-blocking canonical set {C1} is unchanged across the 2-round window: the stall rule fires and the disposition is block_for_operator with the review-stuck non-decreasing reason; C1 is NOT converted to debt.

reviewerFindings.claimDigest: Verification should pin the already-specified retry-count behavior with an executable oracle.
